blockers.question: Which artefact should the FNB submission be — an APK or an AAB? (The app identity, android.package / ios.bundleIdentifier, is the separate half of this blocker and is still open.)
blockers.why_blocked: It decides the entire build path: an APK is installed directly by judges and needs no store account or review; an AAB requires a Google Play listing, a developer account, and review time. No eas.json or package identifier exists, so no build can start either way.
options: AAB, via a Google Play store listing
blockers.recommendation: APK. Judges install an app; they do not browse a store listing, so an APK removes review time and developer-account setup from the critical path.
blockers.answer: APK. Not an AAB, not a store submission.

blockers.question: Confirm the permanent app identifier 'za.co.varsitycompanion' for android.package and ios.bundleIdentifier, and confirm an Expo account email to use for EAS.
blockers.why_blocked: The identifier is permanent once an app is published and cannot be changed later. EAS builds also require an Expo account — the build runs in Expo's cloud, not on this machine. Neither exists yet.
options: A different name tied to the business entity
blockers.recommendation: za.co.varsitycompanion. It matches the .co.za domain and the product name, and it is the kind of identifier a South African business keeps.
